description: Private My Activity tracking: a best-effort logActivity helper spliced into the six success paths (createGroup/joinGroup/createPost/addComment/setReaction-on-set/toggleBookmark), and the protected read-only /activity page plus the Activity left-nav link. Depends on FEAT-001 (activities table/RLS, Activity type, exported timeAgo) and FEAT-002 (toggleBookmark exists so its insert branch can be instrumented). (design.md §2.2, §2.3, §3.7, §3.8.)
steps: In src/app/groups/actions.ts add the private helper `async function logActivity(supabase: SupabaseClient, userId: string, verb: ActivityVerb, opts: { targetType?: string; targetId?: string | null; groupId?: string | null } = {}): Promise<void>` that wraps `supabase.from('activities').insert({ user_id: userId, verb, target_type: opts.targetType ?? null, target_id: opts.targetId ?? null, group_id: opts.groupId ?? null })` in try/catch, console.errors on returned error or thrown exception, and never rethrows. Add `import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';` and import ActivityVerb from '@/types/db' (or inline the union to match).

Splice logActivity into the five existing actions, success-only, before the existing revalidate/redirect/return, changing nothing else (design §2.3): createGroup — after !error and BEFORE redirect(`/groups/${data}`): verb 'created_group', targetType 'group', targetId data, groupId data. joinGroup — after the successful upsert, before revalidatePath: verb 'joined_group', targetType 'group', targetId groupId, groupId groupId.

createPost — emit 'created_post' ONCE PER SUCCESS BRANCH (postRow/textPost are branch-scoped, so a single tail call would not compile): in the image branch after the media-insert success check (postRow in scope) and in the text branch after changing its insert to `.select('id').single<{ id: string }>()` capturing `const { data: textPost, error: postError }` and after its success check (textPost in scope); both with verb 'created_post', targetType 'post', targetId <new post id>, groupId groupId.

addComment — place the call INSIDE the existing `if (post) { ... }` guard, after revalidatePath, so post.group_id is in scope and non-null: verb 'commented', targetType 'post', targetId postId, groupId post.group_id.

setReaction — hoist `let didReact = false;` in the write section; set didReact=true only in the insert (current===null) and switch (current!==type) branches; at the end-of-function post lookup add `if (didReact && post) await logActivity(supabase, user.id, 'reacted', { targetType:'post', targetId:postId, groupId:(post as { group_id: string }).group_id });`. No log on clear.

toggleBookmark (added in FEAT-002) — on the insert (bookmark-on) success branch only, before returning, `await logActivity(supabase, user.id, 'bookmarked', { targetType:'post', targetId: postId });` (no groupId). Never on un-bookmark.

Create src/app/activity/page.tsx (design §3.7): protected read-only Server Component. Env guard -> <SupabaseNotConfigured/>; getUser(); if(!user) redirect('/login'). Fetch `.from('activities').select('id, verb, target_type, target_id, group_id, created_at').order('created_at', { ascending:false }).limit(100).returns<Activity[]>()`; const acts = actsData ?? []. Resolve group names: groupIds = Array.from(new Set(acts.filter(a => a.group_id).map(a => a.group_id!))); if non-empty fetch `.from('groups').select('id, name').in('id', groupIds).returns<{ id: string; name: string }[]>()` else { data: [] as { id: string; name: string }[] }; build a groupNames Map. Render each row as a verb-keyed human-readable line ('You posted in {group}', 'You commented on a post in {group}', 'You reacted to a post in {group}', 'You joined {group}', 'You created the group {group}', 'You saved a post') with a relative timestamp from the exported timeAgo: render verbatim when it equals 'just now' else append ' ago'. Link the group reference to /groups/{group_id} only when resolved in groupNames; otherwise plain text (no per-post route; bookmarked rows carry group_id null -> always plain text). Muted tokens; empty state ('No activity yet.') when empty. Import timeAgo from '@/lib/feed' and Activity from '@/types/db'.
In src/components/dashboard/LeftSidebar.tsx add a new <li> for Activity: `<Link href='/activity' className={linkNavClass}>` with a new ActivityNavIcon SVG in the existing iconClass/stroke style.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with no type or lint errors.
Each primary action keeps its exact existing return shape and side effects; logActivity failures are swallowed (console.error) and never roll back or fail the primary action.

Creating a post records one created_post; commenting one commented; joining a group one joined_group; creating a group one created_group; bookmarking one bookmarked; setting/switching a reaction one reacted; clearing a reaction records none; un-bookmarking records none.

/activity redirects signed-out users to /login; signed in it lists the user's actions newest-first as human-readable lines with relative timestamps; group references link to /groups/{id} when resolvable else plain text; no other user's activity ever appears.
An Activity item appears in the left sidebar and navigates to /activity; muted tokens and an empty state are used.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\Projects\AidPal and confirm no type/lint errors (confirms branch-scoped created_post logging and the text-branch .single<{ id: string }>() typing compile).
Run `npm run test` and confirm all tests pass.
Manually confirm each splice sits on the success path before the existing revalidate/redirect/return and that /activity + the Activity nav link render.
findings: Private helper added in src/app/groups/actions.ts: `async function logActivity(supabase: SupabaseClient, userId: string, verb: ActivityVerb, opts: { targetType?: string; targetId?: string | null; groupId?: string | null } = {}): Promise<void>` — inserts into public.activities (user_id, verb, target_type, target_id, group_id), try/catch, console.error on returned error OR thrown exception, never rethrows (fully best-effort). Imports added: `import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';` and ActivityVerb added to the existing `@/types/db` type import. Six success-only splices, each placed before the existing revalidate/redirect/return and changing no return shape or error path: createGroup -> 'created_group' {targetType:'group',targetId:data,groupId:data} immediately before redirect(`/groups/${data}`); joinGroup -> 'joined_group' {targetType:'group',targetId:groupId,groupId:groupId} before revalidatePath; createPost logs ONCE PER BRANCH -> image branch 'created_post' {targetType:'post',targetId:postRow.id,groupId} after the media-insert success check, text branch changed to `.select('id').single<{ id: string }>()` capturing `const { data: textPost, error: postError }` then 'created_post' {targetType:'post',targetId:textPost.id,groupId} after its success check; addComment -> 'commented' {targetType:'post',targetId:postId,groupId:post.group_id} INSIDE the existing `if (post) { ... }` guard after revalidatePath; setReaction -> hoisted `let didReact = false;` set true only in the insert (current===null) and switch (current!==type) branches, and `if (didReact && post) await logActivity(..., 'reacted', {targetType:'post',targetId:postId,groupId:(post as {group_id:string}).group_id})` at the end-of-function post lookup (no log on clear/toggle-off); toggleBookmark -> 'bookmarked' {targetType:'post',targetId:postId} (no groupId) on the INSERT (bookmark-on) success branch only, never on un-bookmark. New protected route src/app/activity/page.tsx: env guard -> <SupabaseNotConfigured/>; getUser(); !user -> redirect('/login'); fetches activities newest-first `.select('id, verb, target_type, target_id, group_id, created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100).returns<Activity[]>()`; resolves group names via `.from('groups').select('id, name').in('id', groupIds).returns<{id:string;name:string}[]>()` (typed empty fallback when none) into a Map; verb-keyed human-readable lines ('You posted in {group}', 'You commented on a post in {group}', 'You reacted to a post in {group}', 'You joined {group}', 'You created the group {group}', 'You saved a post'); group reference is a Link to /groups/{group_id} only when resolved in groupNames else plain text (bookmarked rows have group_id null -> always plain); relative timestamp via exported timeAgo (rendered verbatim when 'just now' else suffixed ' ago'); muted tokens; empty state 'No activity yet.'. LeftSidebar gained a new ActivityNavIcon SVG (iconClass/stroke style) and an Activity <li> linking to /activity via linkNavClass, placed after the Saved item. build + test both clean (54 tests pass).
